snippet.title: Elementallis ► Official Release Date Trailer (PC, Nintendo Switch, PS4, PS5, Xbox Family)
snippet.description:
Top-down action adventure with elemental magic gameplay. Guilt pushes you on a journey to restore the elements in a pre-apocalyptic world. Use and combine your elemental powers to fight and solve puzzles across the temples. Coming April 28th, 2026 on PC, Switch, PS4/PS5, and the Xbox Family.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304280/Elementallis/
